ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a right-angled polygon composed of horizontal and vertical line segments, with side length units in centimeters, and the figure is not drawn to scale. Observing the vertical sides along the polygon, the downward vertical lengths visible on the right side sequentially include 1 on the top right side, 2 on the outer right side, 1 on the right-side inward step, and 6 on the right side of the lower vertical stem. The upward vertical lengths visible on the left side and upper left side include the unknown X, 2 at the lower-left inward notch, 1 on the far left side, and 1 and 1 on the two upper-left steps. Reasoning: Because this is a closed right-angled polygon, after going once around the figure, the total downward distance in the vertical direction must equal the total upward distance. According to the labels in the figure, the total downward length is 1 + 2 + 1 + 6 = 10. The total upward length is X + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = X + 5. Therefore X + 5 = 10, solving gives X = 5.

method.method_draft: Use vertical displacement closure around the rectilinear polygon. Read from the image the vertical segments encountered when tracing clockwise: downward vertical lengths are 1 at the right side of the top block, 2 on the outer right side, 1 on the inner right step, and 6 on the right side of the lower stem. Upward vertical lengths are X on the left side of the lower stem, 2 on the lower-left inset, 1 on the far-left side, and the two upper-left stair steps of length 1 and 1. Since the polygon closes, total downward vertical distance equals total upward vertical distance: 1+2+1+6 = X+2+1+1+1, giving X=5.

method.method_draft: Use y-coordinate levels from a common top reference. Set the top horizontal segment labeled 2 at height 0. From the top to the bottom of the central lower stem along the right boundary, the image shows vertical drops of 1, then 2, then 1, then 6, so the bottom is 10 cm below the top. From the same top level to the top endpoint of segment X along the left boundary, the image shows drops of 1, 1, 1, and 2, so the top of X is 5 cm below the top. Therefore X is the remaining vertical distance from level 5 down to level 10, so X=10-5=5.
